card.name: Linking words before Dutch-like or anesthesia terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'as' and 'and' just before a noun, mostly 'induction of anesthesia' in drug labels. Also fires inside the brand name BLEMISHERASER and on a few words in old Dutch text.
